issues.location: further-reading note on Church's Journal of Symbolic Logic book reviews
issues.finding: The phrase 'book reviews of the Journal' makes the journal the reviewed object, contrary to the dated series of individual book reviews described by the next sentence.
issues.proposed_resolution: Read 'of the Journal' as 'for the Journal' to identify the journal as the venue.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target says Church wrote the series for the named journal. A bounded comparison view records the clarification; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
